title: FieldScribe Local Clinical Intake
intent: Privacy-first hybrid on-device PHI redaction and clinical care summary studio

lineage.topology: UNIQUE NON-STATIC TOPOLOGY (The well-kept board): The whole page is a board of tiles fitted edge to edge with narrow gaps, like a tidy desk seen from above. Each tile is one thing: the name, a statement, a photograph, a number, a link, a short list. There is no hero and no sequence of bands; the page is one c MUST include bespoke non-repeated layout, real interactive kinetic layer (Canvas/WebGL/animated SVG/drag physics), working slide-out Settings & Detail drawers, and zero static flat card clones.
lineage.motion_engine: Drag row: Live spring-damped motion, drag/scrub interaction, animated transitions

interactive_controls: Primary Stage Interactive Controls (zero dead buttons)
Slide-Over / Bottom-Sheet Settings & Filter Drawer (open, apply, reset, Escape/backdrop close)
Bounded Deck / View Switcher (zero endless scroll)
